verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file at skyvern.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It describes Skyvern for LLM consumption, and a companion /llms page lists the product's capabilities in an agent-readable summary. This delivers the core of pointing an agent at llms.txt-style docs. However, the probe shows no markdown docs variant (docs.md returns 404) and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. Missing for 10: markdown versions of the docs pages, a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, evidence on how deep or complete the llms.txt content is, and independent corroboration of agents using it.
